description.value: North House Tofino is a luxury vacation rental company offering five self-catering properties on the rugged west coast of Vancouver Island, ranging from oceanfront hotel suites to a spacious six-bedroom oceanview home. Properties are positioned near Pacific Rim National Park Reserve and Clayoquot Sound, putting guests within reach of world-class surf beaches, ancient rainforests, and whale-watching opportunities. As a self-catering rental model, guests have private use of full accommodation units rather than traditional hotel services.
